notes: The formation screen and the sealed order (NP_10 s2-3, NP_01 s7). YOUR BOARD: the dressed squad in slots R1..Rk (k = the format's segments, 5 in a sanctioned dual) and reserves (the rest), with 3 staff; sealed at the bell - the corner's swap is the only reorder after it. The four named order archetypes are presets over the board's starters: the ace and the anchor are read from the cards (ace = the highest PWR+SPD+RFX, NP_01 s2.1's Hammer as primary scorer; anchor-class = the highest CHN+BLK+STA of the rest, the keeper analog; ties to the higher stat total, then card order); the Hammer is R4 and the Anchor R5 in a 5-slot board, and a board of 3 or fewer closes on its ace (no anchor slot). THEIR PROJECTION: his probable order, one confidence per slot from the sources the sim has - how readable his coach's archetype is, a scout stand-in covering his club's district, the tactician's +15% (his passive while he is dressed on your board - staff.v1.json since PAC-074), Pattern Intel on the dialect of the fighter in that slot (+5 per level) - capped at 95; below 35 the slot is a silhouette. The percentage is honest: a slot is projected right that often (a roll per slot the seal makes without touching the fight's RNG; the wrong slots trade names among themselves, or with his bench). A coach with decoys runs a decoy seal at his decoy_rate (coaches.v1.json): the projection shows his order shifted one slot, every name wrong, every percentage as confident as ever (NP_10 s3: the confidence % lies); a Tactician at Lv3 on your board (earned by use, staff.v1.json) reads the decoy and the board shows nothing it can trust. A blind dual has no projection. THE OVERLAY: every pairing on the board read by the matchup card's own arithmetic (NP_06 s5): the triangle arrow, the element arrow, the feud banner, the projected EP modifier, one coach note. All numbers and notes are first drafts (editorial, REGISTER_COMMANDS_022).
